Requests:
[t0] I deleted my account and received the confirmation email. Could you verify that the profile is gone and that anything retained for security is limited to what is required?
[t1] I deleted this account and received a confirmation, but the same email address is still recognized. Please remove any remaining copy of my profile.
[t2] I disconnected my account last week, but one of the integrations still seems active. Close the account completely and make sure it can no longer send my data to other systems.
[t3] I found an old report saying my account still existed. Please check the latest state and confirm that the profile is gone and that remaining records cannot identify me.
[t4] I need a copy of last year's invoices for my records. Please leave my profile and purchase history in place.
[t5] I no longer need this account. Please remove my name and contact details, but keeping an internal deleted-account reference is fine if other required records still depend on it.
[t6] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please apply the correct treatment to records covered by the request. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t7] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please apply the request across the systems covered by your deletion policy. Please send a confirmation after the process finishes.
[t8] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t9] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
